title: A watch list
description:
Show named values from your game and highlight the ones that changed.

```
frame 100: hp 20, x 5.0, enemies 3
frame 101: hp 17*, x 5.5*, enemies 3
(* changed since the last frame)
```
hints: Compare the new text with `m_last[name]` and update it afterwards (lesson 12.05).
The game publishes these values; the tool only reads them, which is the safe direction.
requirements: Register values by name with a function that reads them (`std::function<std::string()>`).
Each frame, read all of them and mark the ones whose text changed.
Values come from your own game's state only.
stretch: Keep the last 100 values of number fields and show a sparkline.
